question: Should this branch be refreshed so its baseline diff is removal-only before the protected maintainer landing review?
rationale: The implementation direction is sound, but the current dirty head includes unrelated required-baseline additions whose ownership and landing order cannot be safely accepted implicitly.

options.title: Refresh to removal-only
options.body: Rebase onto current main, regenerate the baseline, and land only if unrelated additions disappear from this PR's diff.

options.title: Own the extra removals
options.body: Expand the PR to remove every newly surfaced unrelated export and add appropriate focused validation for those owner surfaces.

options.title: Wait for sibling cleanups
options.body: Pause until overlapping dead-export cleanup branches land, then regenerate this focused agents patch from a stable base.

recommendation.title: Refresh to removal-only
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, regenerate the baseline, and land only if unrelated additions disappear from this PR's diff.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both the enforced export ratchet and the active cleanup series.
